item.title: ARTEX: The Championship Pentest Tool That Ended Up in the Korean Bank Breach List
item.description: ARTEX, champion of Baidu's agent+ challenge, was turned against nine Korean banks; the upstream repo is down and ThreatBook is commercializing it. Someone on linux.do got shells in two hours.
